.github/workflows/quality.yml.beforeText:
name: Nawasrah code quality

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Only a replaced PR run may cancel; every main/dispatch run has its own group.
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) || format('run-{0}', github.run_id) }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  scope:
    name: CI full or affected scope
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'schedule' || (github.event.repository.private && vars.PRIVATE_CI_BUDGET_MODE == 'true') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    outputs:
      mode: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.mode }}
      full: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.full }}
      core_files: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.core_files }}
      package_f_files: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.package_f_files }}
      package_f_needed: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.package_f_needed }}
      shards: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.shards }}
      shard_count: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.shard_count }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout complete diff history
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Install discovery dependencies only for opt-in affected mode
        if: ${{ github.event.repository.private && vars.PRIVATE_CI_BUDGET_MODE == 'true' && github.event_name != 'schedule' && github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' }}
        run: npm ci && npm --prefix customer-web ci
      - name: Plan unchanged full suite or fail-closed affected partition
        id: plan
        env:
          PRIVATE_CI_BUDGET_MODE: ${{ vars.PRIVATE_CI_BUDGET_MODE }}
          CI_REPOSITORY_PRIVATE: ${{ github.event.repository.private }}
          CI_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
        run: node scripts/testing/plan-private-ci.mjs

  quality:
    name: Lint, test, build and browser QA
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: scope
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: browser-core
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble@sha256:dcc5531e97840b9b5e794f2814476b21571c5124a3fca2267d73041f56e7580e
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: browser-core

      - name: Trust the checked-out workspace in this container
        run: git config --global --add safe.directory "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/browser-core"

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: |
            browser-core/package-lock.json
            browser-core/customer-web/package-lock.json

      - name: Install admin dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install customer store dependencies
        run: npm --prefix customer-web ci

      - name: Verify pinned Playwright image matches lockfile
        run: node scripts/testing/verify-ci-playwright-image.mjs

      - name: Prove dynamic browser partition has no missing or duplicate cases
        run: node scripts/testing/verify-browser-ci-partition.mjs

      - name: Run complete quality gate
        if: needs.scope.outputs.full == 'true'
        env:
          NAWASRAH_CORE_BROWSER_GROUP: chromium
        run: node scripts/testing/run-quality-ci.mjs core

      - name: Run opt-in private push gates and every affected core spec
        if: needs.scope.outputs.full != 'true'
        env:
          PRIVATE_CI_FILES: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.core_files }}
        run: node scripts/testing/run-private-ci.mjs core

      - name: Upload Playwright report on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: playwright-report-core
          path: browser-core/playwright-report/
          retention-days: 14

  core-webkit-browser:
    name: Core WebKit browser QA
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: scope
    if: needs.scope.outputs.full == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: browser-core-webkit
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble@sha256:dcc5531e97840b9b5e794f2814476b21571c5124a3fca2267d73041f56e7580e
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: browser-core-webkit
      - name: Trust the checked-out workspace in this container
        run: git config --global --add safe.directory "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/browser-core-webkit"
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: |
            browser-core-webkit/package-lock.json
            browser-core-webkit/customer-web/package-lock.json
      - name: Install admin dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Install customer store dependencies
        run: npm --prefix customer-web ci
      - name: Verify pinned Playwright image matches lockfile
        run: node scripts/testing/verify-ci-playwright-image.mjs
      - name: Prove complete browser identity coverage before splitting engines
        run: node scripts/testing/verify-browser-ci-partition.mjs
      - name: Run every core WebKit case with original isolation and limits
        run: node scripts/testing/run-core-webkit-ci.mjs
      - name: Upload Playwright report on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: playwright-report-core-webkit
          path: browser-core-webkit/playwright-report/
          retention-days: 14

  package-f-browser:
    name: Package F browser QA (${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ needs.scope.outputs.shard_count }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: scope
    if: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.full == 'true' || needs.scope.outputs.package_f_needed == 'true' }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: ${{ fromJSON(needs.scope.outputs.shards) }}
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: browser-package-f
    # Separate job containers have independent filesystems and network namespaces.
    # No host ports/DB are published; identical localhost ports cannot collide.
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble@sha256:dcc5531e97840b9b5e794f2814476b21571c5124a3fca2267d73041f56e7580e
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: browser-package-f

      - name: Trust the checked-out workspace in this container
        run: git config --global --add safe.directory "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/browser-package-f"

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: |
            browser-package-f/package-lock.json
            browser-package-f/customer-web/package-lock.json

      - name: Install admin dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install customer store dependencies
        run: npm --prefix customer-web ci

      - name: Verify pinned Playwright image matches lockfile
        run: node scripts/testing/verify-ci-playwright-image.mjs

      - name: Prove dynamic browser partition has no missing or duplicate cases
        run: node scripts/testing/verify-browser-ci-partition.mjs

      - name: Run Package F browser gate
        if: needs.scope.outputs.full == 'true'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-quality-ci.mjs package-f --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ needs.scope.outputs.shard_count }}

      - name: Run every affected Package F case on its non-empty shard
        if: needs.scope.outputs.full != 'true'
        env:
          PRIVATE_CI_FILES: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.package_f_files }}
        run: node scripts/testing/run-private-ci.mjs package-f --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ needs.scope.outputs.shard_count }}

      - name: Upload Package F timing and Playwright report
        if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: playwright-report-package-f-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: |
            browser-package-f/playwright-report/
            browser-package-f/ci-browser-metrics/
          retention-days: 14

  pwa-release-update:
    name: Installed admin app release update
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: scope
    if: needs.scope.outputs.mode == 'full'
    timeout-minutes: 10
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble@sha256:dcc5531e97840b9b5e794f2814476b21571c5124a3fca2267d73041f56e7580e
    steps:
      - name: Checkout complete release history
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Trust the checked-out workspace
        run: git config --global --add safe.directory "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - name: Install admin dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Verify pinned Playwright image matches lockfile
        run: node scripts/testing/verify-ci-playwright-image.mjs
      - name: Prove automatic and waiting-worker updates on Chromium and WebKit
        run: npm run test:pwa:release-update

  quality-delivery:
    name: Complete quality delivery gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ always() && needs.scope.result != 'skipped' }}
    needs: [scope, quality, core-webkit-browser, package-f-browser, database-runtime, current-database-runtime, pwa-release-update]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout routed gate
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - name: Verify all routed branches without weakening full delivery
        env:
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          CI_MODE: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.mode }}
          CI_PACKAGE_F_NEEDED: ${{ needs.scope.outputs.package_f_needed }}
        run: node scripts/testing/verify-private-ci-gate.mjs

  database-runtime:
    name: Isolated database runtime regression
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: scope
    if: needs.scope.outputs.full == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install admin dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run historical 001-131 isolated compatibility regression
        env:
          NAWASRAH_MAX_MIGRATION: '131'
        run: npm run test:db:runtime

  current-database-runtime:
    name: Isolated current contracts (${{ matrix.suite }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: scope
    if: needs.scope.outputs.full == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 35
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        suite: [package-d, before-after, phase3, phase3-basic, phase42, phase43, phase44-financial, phase44-lineage, phase44-concurrency, pos-browser, golden-day, supplier-ledger, closing, package-f-reads, package-f-aging, operations-reset, warehouse-management, owner-withdrawals, deferred-cheques, opening-cheques, legacy-product-cost, home-damage201, all-collections202, all-collections203, sales-history204, product-receiving205, navigation-cash206, document-corrections207, supplier-replacement208, parcel209, receipt210, aftercare211, trial212, handover213, handover214, reset214-resume, prelaunch-trial, bulk-product-images, aftercare215, partial216, owner-telegram217, owner-telegram217-operations, home-performance219, home219-operations]
    env:
      NAWASRAH_PACKAGE_D_CURRENT: '1'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          # The before-mode probe reads the reviewed prior132 Git bytes; keep
          # this evidence available after later commits too, not just HEAD^.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install admin dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run current 001-132 Package D public contracts
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-d'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-package-d-database-runtime.mjs

      - name: Rehearse trial reset with real local Auth,Storage bytes and strict182 catalog
        if: matrix.suite == 'operations-reset'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-trial-reset-runtime.mjs

      - name: Prove first owner guarded binding and real TOTP AAL2 without managed access
        if: matrix.suite == 'operations-reset'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-first-owner-runtime.mjs

      - name: Install customer dependencies for the separate temporary trial build gate
        if: matrix.suite == 'prelaunch-trial'
        run: npm --prefix customer-web ci

      - name: Prove prelaunch trial builds,closed-source refusal and preview-only deployment admission
        if: matrix.suite == 'prelaunch-trial'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-prelaunch-trial-builds.mjs

      - name: Prove protected RESET214 retention and four real interruption/restart boundaries
        if: matrix.suite == 'reset214-resume'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-reset214-resume-gates.mjs

      - name: Prove owner warehouse guards,199 upgrade and current trial reset preservation
        if: matrix.suite == 'warehouse-management'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-warehouse-management-gates.mjs

      - name: Prove135 reader JSON,roles and real payment/Return balance
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-reads'
        run: npm run test:package-f:reads

      - name: Prove137 CRM financial filters,old JSON,paging and permissions
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-reads'
        run: npm run test:package-f:crm-filters

      - name: Prove170 product edit conflict between two real sessions,ACL and v3 parity
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-reads'
        run: npm run test:product-edit:runtime

      - name: Prove171 product edits keep stock cost,sale COGS at the true average and owner-only correction
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-reads'
        run: npm run test:product-cost:runtime

      - name: Prove199 legacy cost bypass then200 direct42501 and current internal v4
        if: matrix.suite == 'legacy-product-cost'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-legacy-product-cost-gates.mjs

      - name: Product and receiving205 contracts
        if: matrix.suite == 'product-receiving205'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-product-receiving205-gates.mjs

      - name: Trial package A server receipt search and existing role gates
        if: matrix.suite == 'product-receiving205'
        run: node scripts/audit/run-table-access-diagnostic.mjs --migration-ceiling 208 --require-access --trial-owner-a-search

      - name: Navigation and cash206 contracts
        if: matrix.suite == 'navigation-cash206'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-navigation-cash206-gates.mjs

      - name: Document corrections207 contracts
        if: matrix.suite == 'document-corrections207'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-document-corrections207-gates.mjs
      - name: Parcel209 methods admission races restore upgrade reset and current SDK
        if: matrix.suite == 'parcel209'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-parcel209-gates.mjs

      - name: Receipt210 read-only saved public receipt restore upgrade and current SDK
        if: matrix.suite == 'receipt210'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-receipt210-gates.mjs

      - name: Install pinned Deno graph verifier
        if: matrix.suite == 'handover213' || matrix.suite == 'handover214' || matrix.suite == 'owner-telegram217'
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/nawasrah-y-deno" deno@2.1.4 --no-audit --no-fund
          echo "NAWASRAH_DENO_BINARY=$RUNNER_TEMP/nawasrah-y-deno/node_modules/deno/bin.cjs" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Handover213 security roles tracking Storage frozen Edge and owner upgrade
        if: matrix.suite == 'handover213'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-handover213-gates.mjs

      - name: Handover214 caller authorization exact POS Maps shift guard lock-order and strict owner upgrade
        if: matrix.suite == 'handover214'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-handover214-gates.mjs

      - name: Trial212 read-only roles source metadata restore upgrade reset and current SDK
        if: matrix.suite == 'trial212'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-trial212-gates.mjs

      - name: Aftercare211 supplier disposition roles races restore upgrade reset and current SDK
        if: matrix.suite == 'aftercare211'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-aftercare211-gates.mjs

      - name: Supplier replacement208 contracts
        if: matrix.suite == 'supplier-replacement208'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-supplier-replacement208-gates.mjs

      - name: Sales history204 contracts
        if: matrix.suite == 'sales-history204'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-sales-history204-gates.mjs

      - name: All actual customer receipts203 contracts
        if: matrix.suite == 'all-collections203'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-all-collections203-gates.mjs

      - name: All customer collections202 contracts
        if: matrix.suite == 'all-collections202'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-all-collections202-gates.mjs

      - name: Home collected and immutable damage201 contracts
        if: matrix.suite == 'home-damage201'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-home-damage201-gates.mjs
      - name: Prove136 read-only FIFO aging,canonical balance and role boundaries
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-aging'
        run: npm run test:package-f:aging

      - name: Prove138 customer statement movements,canonical balance,paging and ACL
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-aging'
        run: npm run test:package-f:statement

      - name: Prove160+ go-live setup lock,opening balances parity,WAC and permissions
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-aging'
        run: npm run test:go-live:runtime

      - name: Prove196 opening cheques preserve net balances and share the permanent setup lock
        if: matrix.suite == 'opening-cheques'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-opening-cheques-runtime.mjs

      - name: Prove197 canonical home receivables and independent CRITICAL mismatch monitoring
        if: matrix.suite == 'opening-cheques'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-canonical-receivables197-runtime.mjs

      - name: Prove197 full two-year legal equality and existing3s home gate with independent balances p95
        if: matrix.suite == 'opening-cheques'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-canonical-receivables197-scale.mjs

      - name: Cashier collection198 real roles and unchanged reversal guards
        if: matrix.suite == 'opening-cheques'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-cashier-collections198-runtime.mjs

      - name: Prove164 independent complete cash shift and measure receivable status sets
        if: matrix.suite == 'closing'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-go-live-integration164-runtime.mjs

      - name: Prove164 fresh versus incremental catalog and owner upgrade without managed access
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-reads'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-frankfurt-upgrade164-runtime.mjs

      - name: Prove182 owner-only withdrawals,atomic reversal,closing race,monitoring and strict logical restore
        if: matrix.suite == 'owner-withdrawals'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-owner-withdrawals-runtime.mjs

      - name: Prove182 independent full cash day preserves unified opening collections and supplier payments
        if: matrix.suite == 'owner-withdrawals'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-withdrawals-integration182-runtime.mjs

      - name: Prove182 fresh and incremental catalogs and owner pipeline with no managed access
        if: matrix.suite == 'owner-withdrawals'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-frankfurt-upgrade182-runtime.mjs

      - name: Prove171 fresh versus incremental catalog,closed legacy writers and owner upgrade locally
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-reads'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-frankfurt-upgrade171-runtime.mjs

      - name: Prove daily Supabase REST read and database-size read on isolated schema
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-aging'
        run: npm run test:monitoring:daily:runtime

      - name: Prove generated public function reference exactly matches isolated current schema
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-aging'
        run: npm run docs:db-functions:check

      - name: Prove owner ACL alignment transaction,stale preview and atomic rollback in isolation
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-aging'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-frankfurt-acl-alignment-runtime.mjs

      - name: Prove139 configured URL,no-send fallback and unchanged notification hold
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-aging'
        run: npm run test:order-push:runtime

      - name: Verify exact table privileges150 above138 and139
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-reads'
        run: npm run test:table-reads150:runtime

      - name: Require real application table access through198
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-reads'
        run: node scripts/audit/run-table-access-diagnostic.mjs --require-access

      - name: Prove cheque lifecycle,compensation,FIFO,roles,atomicity,drawer and monitoring
        if: matrix.suite == 'deferred-cheques'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-deferred-cheques-runtime.mjs

      - name: Prove cheque fresh and incremental catalogs match with official history
        if: matrix.suite == 'deferred-cheques'
        run: node scripts/operations/build-acl-reference-cheques.mjs --output "${{ runner.temp }}/nawasrah-cheques-reference/local-reference-through195-ready.json"

      - name: Prove198 final reference and literal171 upgrade with preserved notification hold
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-reads'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-frankfurt-upgrade198-runtime.mjs

      - name: Prove151 real Realtime channel delivery and role isolation
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-reads'
        run: npm run test:realtime151:runtime
      - name: Rehearse owner139-150-151 upgrade and strict publication verification locally
        if: matrix.suite == 'package-f-reads'
        run: npm run test:frankfurt151:runtime

      - name: Reconcile a complete business day through real public RPCs
        if: matrix.suite == 'golden-day'
        run: npm run test:package-e:golden

      - name: Prove supplier PO financial paths before132 and after133
        if: matrix.suite == 'supplier-ledger'
        run: npm run test:package-e:supplier

      - name: Prove closing presentation and fallback before132 and after133
        if: matrix.suite == 'closing'
        run: npm run test:package-e:closing

      - name: Prove Package D before and after on real historical fixtures
        if: matrix.suite == 'before-after'
        env:
          NAWASRAH_PACKAGE_D_MODE: before
        run: node scripts/testing/run-package-d-database-runtime.mjs

      - name: Run Phase 3 on current132 after historical fixtures
        if: matrix.suite == 'phase3'
        run: npm run test:phase3-contracts:runtime

      - name: Rerun basic Phase 3 SQL fixture after132 on fresh schema
        if: matrix.suite == 'phase3-basic'
        run: node scripts/testing/run-phase3-basic-current-runtime.mjs

      - name: Run Phase 4.2 on current132 after historical fixtures
        if: matrix.suite == 'phase42'
        run: npm run test:phase42-return:runtime

      - name: Run current Phase 4.3 Admin aftercare and historical read-only contracts
        if: matrix.suite == 'phase43'
        run: npm run test:phase43-aftercare:runtime

      - name: Run current132 financial integration
        if: matrix.suite == 'phase44-financial'
        run: npm run test:phase44-financial:runtime

      - name: Run current132 lineage integration
        if: matrix.suite == 'phase44-lineage'
        run: npm run test:phase44-lineage:runtime

      - name: Run current132 concurrency integration
        if: matrix.suite == 'phase44-concurrency'
        run: npm run test:phase44-concurrency:runtime

      - name: Install customer browser dependencies
        if: matrix.suite == 'pos-browser'
        run: npm --prefix customer-web ci

      - name: Install fullstack browsers
        if: matrix.suite == 'pos-browser' || matrix.suite == 'bulk-product-images' || matrix.suite == 'aftercare215' || matrix.suite == 'partial216'
        run: |
          # Keep Ubuntu's signed packages; avoid the Azure mirror that exhausted
          # the job budget twice while downloading browser system dependencies.
          sudo sed -i '\|^https\?://azure\.archive\.ubuntu\.com/ubuntu/[[:space:]]|d' /etc/apt/apt-mirrors.txt
          grep -q '^https://archive\.ubuntu\.com/ubuntu/' /etc/apt/apt-mirrors.txt
          if grep -Fq 'azure.archive.ubuntu.com' /etc/apt/apt-mirrors.txt; then
            echo '::error::Azure apt mirror was not removed'
            exit 1
          fi
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium webkit

      - name: Partial216 atomic payment quick customer strict upgrade reset resume and current SDK
        if: matrix.suite == 'partial216'

## Promotion redemption

- Cancel/expiry before Completion restores quota/eligibility.
- Partial or full Return after Completion does not restore automatically.
- Compensation uses a new replacement promotion/coupon.
- Policy is approved; implementation may remain deferred by approved scope. Do not reopen the decision.

## Return/refund financial policy

- For partially paid sales, reduce the outstanding debt first using authoritative execution-time debt and net collected amount for that sale. Refund only the remaining entitlement backed by money actually collected.
- Delivery is a separate service and is not automatically refunded or prorated on merchandise Return. A full merchandise Return may leave a delivery balance.
- Tax treatment must not be invented where still outside an approved implemented contract.
- Retry of one Return must not repeat debt reduction or money refund.

## Parcel and damaged goods

- Sales Parcel Return/Refund is whole Parcel Instance only.
- Settling a Parcel Return consumes that Parcel identity as Return entitlement, including when components are rejected for `CUSTOMER_DAMAGE`; accepted/rejected quantities and reasons remain evidence.
- Customer-damage deduction equals rejected quantity times the immutable historical **effective standalone Base Unit sale price** at the authoritative price-freeze point. Never use current price, current offer, Parcel allocation, COGS, or WAC. Clamp deductions to the original Parcel refundable entitlement.
- POS captures that snapshot at sale. Customer V2 captures it when commercial price/composition is frozen; Completion only starts the Return window and does not reprice it.

## Replacement lineage

- Customer replacement stock comes from sellable inventory; the damaged unit does not return to sellable inventory.
- Supplier claim/replacement/credit is a separate later operation and no Supplier Credit is created merely by storing defect evidence.
- Replacement does not restart the 48-hour window. Eligibility is anchored to original authoritative Completion.
- A defective replacement may be replaced again only within that original window and with lineage to the original unit.
- A current replacement can represent the original component in a later whole-Parcel Return; refund remains based on original-sale entitlement, not replacement cost.
- Replacement stock outflow gets its own cost snapshot under inventory policy and does not reinterpret original COGS.
- If that replacement is the current physical representative in a later Return, sellable restock valuation uses its immutable replacement-time cost snapshot. Current WAC is not a Return valuation source, and lineage consumption must not consume the original source twice.

## Deadline

### Phase 6 Base Return allocation (owner approved 2026-10-06)

For a selected partial Base Return, original `base_order_item` capacity is allocated first.
Operational replacement leaves follow issuance date oldest-to-newest, then lineage depth,
then sourceId as the final deterministic tie-breaker. If issuance dates are incomplete,
use lineage depth then sourceId. Only the existing public aftercare read facts are used;
incomplete or contradictory lineage fails closed. This does not change DB valuation,
capacity, entitlement or current-leaf authority.

- A new operation is allowed when authoritative DB time is `<= completed_at + 48 hours` after locks are acquired and state is revalidated.
- Opening UI does not reserve eligibility.
- Exact same-key replay of an already committed operation returns its stored result even after the deadline.

Cash/CliQ sales fields, shift counters, payment vouchers and drawer calculations
remain unchanged. Show initial completion payments recorded as vouchers as a
separate sales line (with tender), and annotate collections with its included
amount. New credit sales are the portion unpaid at completion, not current debt
after subsequent payments/returns. Gross = existing Cash/CliQ sales + initial
voucher payments + unpaid-at-completion credit. Never add those initial payments
again to total inflows. Closed historical snapshots stay byte-identical. The
owner authorizes this live reader and Admin presentation in uncommitted133.

Closing net sales = gross minus settled merchandise Return entitlement
(monetary refunds + debt reduction). Present both components separately: the
golden day is67 - (12 +3) =52. Debt reduction is never drawer outflow or a
second refund. This reader-only correction in133 must preserve vouchers,
reconciliation and every old closed snapshot. Stop at any fourth numeric gap.

### Package E supplier balance (owner approved 2026-10-07)

Supplier balance equals active direct and PO receipts minus every active payment.
PO advance payment creates supplier credit (negative balance) until receiving.
Payment, receiving-time payment, reversal and receipt cancellation apply each
movement once. Updated owner correction authorizes133 to recalculate every
supplier once from receipt/payment evidence with old/new audit, replacing the
earlier no-backfill limitation. Production remains off limits. Legacy PO V1
without a payable snapshot uses recorded receipt cost only. Exact fully received,
non-cancelled matching PO/item receipts use final net PO payable once, without
per-receipt allocation. Partial/price-mismatched adjusted POs retain recorded
cost and an audited manual-review flag/potential difference. V2 snapshot113

Owner option1: new receiving uses V2 only and never saves product defaults or

Positive supplier debts and negative advances are reported separately.134 is

# تحضير البيانات قبل التشغيل

ستة ملفات Excel ببيانات وهمية فقط. لا تُدخلها كما هي في المحل. احذف صف المثال في «البيانات»، واملأ بياناتك، ولا تغيّر عناوين الصف الأول أو ترتيب الأعمدة. ورقة «تعليمات ومراجعة» فيها الشرح والتحققات؛ لا تُرفع منفصلة إلى النظام. الاستيراد يقرأ أول ورقة فقط.

| الملف | من أين يدخل؟ | ملاحظته |
|---|---|---|
| المنتجات.xlsx | بداية التشغيل ← المنتجات ← تنزيل القالب / اختيار الملف في مسار الاستيراد | نفس أعمدة القالب الحالية حرفياً. إضافات «من النموذج» للتحضير اليدوي فقط، وليست أعمدة استيراد |
| البضاعة-الموجودة.xlsx | بداية التشغيل ← البضاعة الموجودة | طرود + وحدات إضافية؛ محتوى الطرد يؤخذ من الصنف في النظام |
| أرصدة-الموردين.xlsx | بداية التشغيل ← أرصدة الموردين الافتتاحية | له: نحن مدينون له. عليه: هو مدين لنا. صف صافي واحد لكل مورد |
| ديون-العملاء.xlsx | بداية التشغيل ← ديون العملاء القديمة | كل دين بتاريخه الأصلي، ليس بيعاً ولا ربحاً ولا حركة درج |
| شيكات-البداية.xlsx | بداية التشغيل ← شيكات البداية | متابعة فقط. الأطراف موجودة وفريدة. الأرصدة المدخلة صافية بعد الشيكات |
| الدرج-الافتتاحي.xlsx | الصندوق والورديات ← العهدة الافتتاحية (د.أ) ← فتح وردية جديدة | تحضير وعدّ يدوي فقط، لا استيراد لهذا الملف ولا بطاقة درج في بداية التشغيل |

## الترتيب والقواعد

1. أكّد الفرع والمستودع والوحدات والأقسام. قوائم المثال ليست قائمة أصنافك؛ بدّل أسماءها بالأسماء المطابقة حرفياً في النظام.
2. عرّف المنتجات ثم راجع «طريقة البيع» والأسعار والنكهات من النموذج. قالب المنتجات يدعم «بيتباع بالطرد بس» بنعم/لا، لكنه لا يضم عمود سعر وحدة مستقل أو قائمة نكهات أو السماح بالمشكّل. لا تضف أعمدة غير مدعومة لتتوقع استيرادها.
3. في القالب: حجم طرد البيع 1 مع «لا» يعني البيع بالوحدة؛ أكثر من 1 مع «نعم» للطرد فقط؛ أكثر من 1 مع «لا» للطرد والوحدة. استكمل «طريقة البيع» من النموذج وراجع السعر المحسوب قبل التشغيل. النكهات تُنشأ تحت أصلها من نموذج المنتج.
4. أدخل البضاعة الموجودة من مسارها الافتتاحي. لا تستعمل استلام شراء للمخزون الافتتاحي. المنتج الأساسي ذو النكهات لا يُجرد؛ جرد كل نكهة برمزها أو باركودها.
5. طابق الموردين والعملاء والشيكات على ورقة موقّعة أولاً. **الدين القديم ليس بيعاً.**
6. **قرار الشيك قبل الإدخال:** حدّد هل المبلغ في الدفتر قبل خصم الشيك أم صافي بعده. تسجيل «شيكات البداية» للمتابعة فقط، لا يخصم الذمة مرة ثانية. يجب أن تكون أرصدة البداية المدخلة صافية بعد الشيكات. إذا كان الشيك قد خُصم، لا تخصمه مرة أخرى؛ إن كان مستقلاً عن الدفتر فاحسم صافي الطرف قبل الاستيراد. توقيع القرار في ورقة الشيك لا يغيّر طريقة النظام ولا ينشئ حقلاً جديداً فيه.
7. الشيك التشغيلي الجديد بعد التشغيل مختلف: يخفض الدين عند التسجيل من دورة الشيكات. لا تستخدمه بدلاً من شيك البداية لمجرد أن الشاشة متاحة.
8. اكتب المال بالدينار وبثلاث خانات كحد أقصى، والكميات أعداداً صحيحة. الباركود ورقم الشيك والهاتف نصوص لحفظ الأصفار. لا تحولها إلى أرقام.
9. لا تستعمل صف الشرح أو ورقة المراجعة كسطر استيراد. المثال موجود في الصف 2 وحده، وموسوم في التعليمات بأنه وهمي ويُحذف. افتح معاينة النظام وراجع أخطاءه قبل الحفظ؛ قوائم Excel وصيغه مساعدة وليست بديلاً عنها.
10. بعد المطابقة و«افحص» فقط: «إنهاء بداية التشغيل» قفل نهائي. بعدها عدّ الدرج الحقيقي وافتح أول وردية، دون تحصيل أو مصروف وهمي لتكوين المبلغ.

الحدود الحالية: الملف حتى 5MB و5000 صف في القارئ العام، وشيكات البداية حتى 500 سطر. المنتجات تُحفظ بدفعات 100، والمخزون والعملاء والموردون بدفعات 200 في مسار الواجهة. التاريخ الأصلي للعملاء والموردين من 2000-01-01 حتى اليوم بتوقيت عمّان. الملاحظات في أرصدة الأطراف حتى 300 حرف. الوحدات الإضافية أقل من محتوى الطرد، وإجمالي الكمية لا يتجاوز 2147483647. تكلفة الصنف الموجب المخزون يجب أن تكون موجبة في النظام.

أسماء مثل SKU والباكيت باقية **في رؤوس قالب النظام الحالي**؛ أُبقيت حرفياً لضمان القراءة، ولا تعني تغيير اسم «رمز الصنف» في نموذج المنتج أو تسمية «طرد» في الدليل.

المصدر: واجهة وقوالب main ad4bd1f8230758a707285ceb8f0042015d16b018. لا توجد بيانات محل أو زبائن في هذه الملفات.

## تسمية صور المنتجات

بعد إدخال المنتجات: رفع مجلد الصور من «بداية التشغيل» أو «المنتجات» ← «رفع صور المنتجات حسب الرمز». اسم الملف بدون الامتداد = رمز الصنف بالضبط، مثل SUG-10.jpg، وصورة مستقلة لكل نكهة برمزها مثل PRG-BBQ.jpg. لا تطابق بالاسم. المقارنة تتجاهل حالة الأحرف والمسافات الطرفية، وتوحّد الأرقام العربية والهندية. اختر خلفية فاتحة. JPG / PNG / WebP حتى 5MB للصورة، و500 ملف للدفعة؛ تُضغط محلياً قبل الرفع. راجع المعاينة والتكرار وخيار الاستبدال قبل التأكيد؛ الصورة الحالية تُتخطّى افتراضياً. إعادة اختيار الملفات نفسها تتخطى ما حُفظ.
